vsProforma.basis: Fastest direct proforma on the pair with an in-window September departure, taken across all three queryable sources: MSC/ZIM EMERALD SERVICE, ZIM CANADA 20E, Yantian 07 Sep to Savannah 05 Oct, 28d; Evergreen AUE, EVER MAX 1374-016E, 29d; Hapag US1, MAERSK LIRQUEN, 30d. OGEC TRITON runs 27d, so it is one day faster than the best proforma on this pair. Do not over-read that: on Yantian to New York the same voyage runs 31d against a fastest proforma of 26d (Evergreen SAX, OOCL DAFFODIL 006E, etd 10 Sep), a 5-day penalty. The honest summary is that TRITON is competitive to Savannah and clearly slower to New York, and should be priced as added capacity rather than as an expedited product. Note the movement since last run: last run put this pair at proforma 25d against OGEC 26d for delta +1, because MSC's fastest string then was ZIM MOUNT RAINIER 13E at 25d. That sailing is no longer in the September departure set and MSC's best has slipped to 28d, while OGEC slipped from 26d to 27d. Both numbers moved; the sign flipped for that reason, not because the product changed.

alerts.subject: MSC request contract confirmed
alerts.detail: Last run's MSC recipe replicated cleanly and is now confirmed rather than provisional. POST /api/feature/tools/SearchSailingRoutes with header X-Requested-With XMLHttpRequest and a JSON body using PascalCase keys FromPortId, ToPortId, FromDate, ToDate, WeeksOut, Language. Two things worth pinning down: the same path answered with GET returns HTTP 500 and an HTML error page, so it must be POST; and camelCase body keys (fromPortId and so on) also return HTTP 200 with valid data, so the API is case-insensitive on the body and either form works. SearchPorts ignores its term parameter entirely and returns all 606 ports regardless, which is convenient - fetch it once and resolve every LOCODE locally. Port ids re-verified this run: CNYTN 2, CNSHA 444, CNNGB 441, KRPUS 274, USNYC 79, USSAV 70, USHOU 86, and Cai Mep still filed as VNVUT VUNG TAU 1292.

alerts.subject: vsProforma baselines
alerts.detail: All three published items have deltas computed against the fastest direct proforma on the pair across every source queryable this run, which for the first time includes Evergreen's own strings. That matters: on two of the three baselines Evergreen was the fastest carrier and would have been missed under a Hapag-plus-MSC comparison. Pusan to New York, Evergreen NUE2 22d beat MSC EMPIRE 23d and Hapag US2 24d. Shanghai to New York, Evergreen SAX 22d beat MSC EMPIRE 26d and Hapag US2 27d. Ningbo to New York, Evergreen NUE2 25d beat MSC EMPIRE 27d. Corrected read for the desk, unchanged in substance from last run: none of the three items is an expedited product. TRITON is the only one that beats a proforma anywhere, by one day to Savannah, and it is 5 days slower to New York. EVER LASTING is 6 to 12 days slower depending on origin. AA9 is 13 days slower. All three should be priced as space relief.
